name: Russian
about: An alphabet like English, with some look-alike letters that sound different. Russian cursive looks quite different from print.

phrases.how: Look-alikes trick you: р is 'r', в is 'v', and е is 'ye'.
phrases.why: Greet someone in their own script on a card or a note.
phrases.dictation: Six letters: п р и в е т. Informal hello.

phrases.how: с is 's' and б is 'b'. We practise print; handwritten cursive looks different.
phrases.why: Write a real thank-you card to a host or to family.
phrases.dictation: Seven letters: с п а с и б о.

phrases.how: Unstressed о often sounds like 'a': вода is said 'va-DA'.
phrases.why: Spot it on a menu, a sign or a bottle label.
phrases.dictation: Four letters: в о д а.

phrases.how: д is 'd', у is 'oo' and г is 'g'. In cursive, д and г look very different.
phrases.why: Sign a note to a friend. Writing it by hand helps you remember it.
phrases.dictation: Four letters: д р у г.

phrases.how: и is 'ee' and н is 'n', not 'h'. Stress the second syllable: a-DEEN.
phrases.why: Read quantities and order one of something off a menu.
phrases.dictation: Four letters: о д и н.
